children: Koil Energy Solutions closed a private placement on October 29, 2026, raising approximately $5.6 million in gross proceeds before fees and expenses. The financing includes common shares priced at $2.50 each and pre-funded warrants, and investors receive resale registration rights. Lucid Capital Markets served as sole placement agent, earning a fee of 6% of gross proceeds plus $50,000 in expense reimbursement.
